from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,time,hashlib
base=Path.cwd();task=base/'.local/tool-tasks/exhaust-order-pruning-20261007'
prior=json.loads((base/'docs/performance/retained-victory-strict-hp-pruning-20261007.json').read_text());records=[]
for scene in ['dev-08-regent-boss','dev-09-necrobinder-boss','dev-06-silent-boss']:
 control=next(r for r in prior['performance']['runs'] if r['scene']==scene and r['label']=='C1')
 out=task/'observer'/scene;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 cmd=control['plan']['command'].copy();cmd[cmd.index('--out')+1]=str(out);cmd[cmd.index('--label')+1]='exhaust-order-'+scene
 env=os.environ.copy()
 for key in list(env):
  if key.startswith('OFFLINE_HARNESS_') or key.startswith('COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY') or key in ['DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled','COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled','COMBATSOLVER_MEASUREMENT_TRACE']:env.pop(key,None)
 dll=task/'build-observer/CombatSolver.dll';env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']=str(dll)
 exports=out/'member-exports';exports.mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TASK_EXHAUST_ORDER_OUT']=str(exports)
 plan={'command':cmd,'outerTimeoutSeconds':120,'diagnosticOnly':True,'deletesBranches':False,'sourceBase':'c62b5c95','requestSha256':control['plan']['requestSha256'],'dllSha256':hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest()};(out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
 start=time.monotonic()
 with (out/'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
  p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  try:code=p.wait(timeout=120);status='Completed' if code==0 else 'Failed'
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait();code=p.returncode;status='TimeoutNoRetry'
 row={'scene':scene,'status':status,'exitCode':code,'launcherWallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'plan':plan}
 if status=='Completed':
  d=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text());row.update({k:d[k] for k in ['wallSeconds','peakProcessWorkingSetBytes','comparisonQuality','budget','solverMetrics','pruneCounters','rootContinuationStamp']})
  row['policy']=json.loads((out/'search-policy.json').read_text());row['observations']=[]
  for path in [exports/'all-members.json']:
   row['observations'].append(json.loads(path.read_text()))
  row['controlMatch']={'quality':row['comparisonQuality']==control['comparisonQuality'],'root':hashlib.sha256(row['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest()==control['rootStampSha256'],'policy':row['policy']==control['policy'],'budget':row['budget']==control['budget']}
 records.append(row);(task/'observer-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({k:row.get(k) for k in ['scene','status','wallSeconds','controlMatch']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 if status!='Completed':raise SystemExit('Terminal result retained; no unchanged retry.')
